capabilities: Move the active or selected files to the folder of their backlinking file
Trigger the move only when exactly one backlink exists
Undo moves with the File Undo plugin
Run the move via the command 'Move to the folders of linking ("parent") files, if single backlink'
extras: Author suggests installing via BRAT from GitHub if installation fails, and assigning a hotkey (author uses F3). Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to file a note based on which note links to it.

relations.evidence: Moves can be undone with the plugin File Undo.
Also helpful to organize into folders is my plugin Move to subfolder.

summary: Command that moves the active or selected file into the folder of its single backlinking file.
